tool_config.name: withdraw_request
tool_config.description: Withdraw (cancel) one of the Foreman's own Requests that find_open_requests returned, after the Foreman confirmed it. The backend decides whether it is applied: before the Owner is working on it, it is withdrawn and returns {"applied": true}; once it is In Progress or Resolved nothing is changed, the office is flagged, and it returns {"applied": false}. Returns {"error": "..."} if it could not be withdrawn.

ref.description: The ref of the Request as find_open_requests returned it, for example R-1042.
